narrative.overview: This is the visual language of a premium sports club that happens to have a world-class cafe — not a cafe that happens to have courts. The system channels competitive energy through refined, dark-toned aesthetics: olive-tinged blacks that feel like walking into a members' club after hours, lime accents that pulse like court lighting, and warm taupe that softens the social spaces. The design rejects all traces of generic sports facility websites and AI-generated SaaS defaults. It is firmly, unapologetically dark.
keyCharacteristics: Space Grotesk display with extrabold weights
Purposeful motion — entrance reveals and scroll triggers

rules.name: The Olive-Black Rule
rules.body: The body background is never pure black (#000000) and never cold gray (#111827). Brand Dark (#18180c) is the floor.

rules.name: The One-Domain-Accent Rule
rules.body: Each page uses exactly one accent palette: courts = lime, cafe = amber, corporate = blue. Mixing accents within a page is forbidden.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Restraint Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase tracking labels appear at most once per three sections. When in doubt, drop the eyebrow.

rules.name: The Tonal-Layering Rule
rules.body: Depth on dark backgrounds is conveyed through opacity shifts on surfaces, not through drop shadows.

dos: Use domain accent color exclusively within its route
Use Space Grotesk extrabold for display text
Keep warm olive undertone in all dark surfaces
Implement full loading/empty/error states on booking forms
Use Framer Motion for entrance animations under 600ms
donts: Use pure black (#000000) for any surface
Use purple gradients, neon accents, glassmorphism as decoration, or cream backgrounds
Use Inter as the display font
Add drop shadows to cards as decoration
Put an eyebrow label above every section header
Use stock photos for court or cafe imagery
Use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe
